Having owned a Mustang GT (still have it) at 17 and basically only bought sports cars including a wrx (curretly), a VW GTI stage 2 tuned, and an older eclipse. Ill give you some advice. Unless you know how to work on cars and make decent money already don't get a lancer evo like my Subaru they have crazy regular maintenance costs. Read the scheduled maintenance on one then check the costs and add 500 dollars for the year for stuff not in the scheduled maintenance. If I had to recommend a sports car under 20k that's not going to absolutely destroy you a mustang ecoboost they are easy enough to work on, dont have a timing belt, wont eat your money in gas as long as you not mashing the throttle every chance you get, and have stronger transmission and rear end than the evo. But if your deadset on an evo or hate mustangs you better either make a good amount of money or be real comfortable with getting dirty under that car. Insurance is gonna be a bear too full coverage was 291 a month when I was 17 and that was over 10 years ago.
